issues.description: Missing probability/frequency data for events. Spec says '10% chance per turn' but doesn't specify individual event weights or selection algorithm.
issues.suggestion: Add EVENT_WEIGHTS JSON table with probability for each event type. Include selection algorithm.

issues.description: Missing trigger conditions. Requirements specify documenting when each event can trigger but spec only lists effects.
issues.suggestion: Add 'Trigger Conditions' field to each event specifying turn requirements, tech prerequisites, galaxy state requirements.

issues.description: Missing key MOO1 events: Guardian of Orion, Space Pirates, Comet, Rebellion, Supernova, Leaders/Scientists.
issues.suggestion: Add Guardian of Orion (Orion system), Space Pirates (random raids), Comet (destroys planet), Rebellion (colony revolt), Supernova (star death), Leader recruitment events.

issues.description: No JSON data structures provided despite requirements specifying them.
issues.suggestion: Add JSON blocks for EVENT_TYPES, EVENT_WEIGHTS, MONSTER_STATS, DISASTER_EFFECTS constants.

issues.description: Missing duration information for events that have lasting effects.
issues.suggestion: Specify duration in turns for ongoing effects like plague, trade disputes, etc.

issues.description: Space monsters are generic - need pet-themed names per LORE.md conventions.
issues.suggestion: Rename to pet-themed: 'Space Hamster Swarm', 'Crystal Goldfish', 'Cosmic Parrot' etc.

summary: Random Events specification is incomplete and not implementation-ready. Missing critical requirements: probability weights, trigger conditions, key MOO1 events (Guardian, Comet, Rebellion), JSON data structures, and duration fields. Content is too brief and lacks the algorithmic detail needed for implementation. Needs substantial expansion to meet spec-021 requirements.
